component.name: Noctalia Themes
Thèmes Noctalia
component.summary: Apply and remove Noctalia themes, with rollback
Appliquer et retirer des thèmes Noctalia, avec retour arrière

description.p: Decorative themes for the Noctalia v5 desktop shell: palette, wallpapers, desktop widgets and the login screen, applied in one click and removed just as cleanly. Every apply is backed up first; the settings you change while a theme is active survive its removal.
Themes come as .zip packages: drop one on the window to add it. A package can only change the look: it cannot run commands or reach files outside its own folder.
